 Growth Strategies 

 

 Our growth strategies include the following: 

 

 
 
 
 ● 
 Extending engagements with OEMs and driving stack providers: While we keep focus on the well-established production path with our Tier 1 customers, we are extending our focus to better fit the age-of-autonomy: Working directly with OEM’s feature owners, perception teams and driving stack providers (like NVIDIA and others) to enhance the mutual understanding for the need for an imaging radar and how it is to be used for advanced ADAS and higher level of autonomy.
